name: Loan Data 138
definition: Specifies the loan data details in case of a margin lending transaction.

UniqueTradeIdentifier.name: Unique Trade Identifier
UniqueTradeIdentifier.definition: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

EventDate.name: Event Date
EventDate.definition: Date on which the reportable event pertaining to the transaction and captured by the report took place.

ExecutionDateTime.name: Execution Date Time
ExecutionDateTime.definition: Indicates the date and time when the contract was executed.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Identification of the trading venue where the transaction was executed.

CollateralDeliveryMethod.name: Collateral Delivery Method
CollateralDeliveryMethod.definition: Specifies whether the collateral is subject to a title transfer collateral arrangement, a securities interest collateral arrangement, or a securities interest with the right of use.

OutstandingMarginLoanAmount.name: Outstanding Margin Loan Amount
OutstandingMarginLoanAmount.definition: Total amount of margin loans in base currency.

ShortMarketValueAmount.name: Short Market Value Amount
ShortMarketValueAmount.definition: Market value of short position in base currency.

MarginLoanAttribute.name: Margin Loan Attribute
MarginLoanAttribute.definition: Data on amount and interest rates of the transaction.

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Termination date in the case of a full early termination of the Securities Financing Transaction (SFT).
